title: Crispy Oyster Crumble Bliss Bites
description: Crispy oyster bites with a crumbly topping, inspired by the flavors of bliss.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the crumble, bliss, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the oysters to the bowl and gently toss to coat with the crumble mixture.
Arrange the oysters on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dot the top of each oyster with a pat of butter.
Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the oysters are cooked through.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
